title: Documentation.AI Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Documentation.AI documentation sites

name.description: Site name displayed in browser title, navigation header, and social media previews

logo.description: Single logo used when no theme-specific logo is set. Relative paths are allowed.

initialRoute.description: Default page path when users visit the root URL. Path to MDX file without .mdx extension

template.description: Site template that selects the base layout and style

theme.description: Typography and accent overrides applied on top of the template.

primaryColor.description: Accent colour applied to interactive elements.

favicon.description: Favicon for browser tabs: an absolute URL or a root-relative path (e.g. /favicon.png)

logo-dark.description: Main logo displayed in dark theme. Absolute URL or root-relative path. Supports PNG, SVG, WEBP

logo-light.description: Main logo displayed in light theme. Absolute URL or root-relative path

logo-small-dark.description: Small logo/favicon for dark theme. Used in browser tabs and mobile view. Absolute URL or root-relative path

logo-small-light.description: Small logo/favicon for light theme. Absolute URL or root-relative path

redirects.description: URL redirects array. First matching redirect takes precedence

customCss.description: Custom CSS files applied to every documentation page. They load after the theme, so their rules win. Entries must be objects; a bare string is skipped at deploy time.

src.description: A .css file relative to the repository root (e.g. 'styles/brand.css'), or an external https:// URL. Local files are capped at 1 MB each; a missing or oversized file is skipped rather than failing the deploy.

scripts.description: Custom JavaScript files to load on all documentation pages. Supports local files (.js/.mjs in the repo) and external URLs

src.description: Path to a local JS file or external URL

category.description: Consent category name matching a key in integrations.cookies. Defaults to 'essential' (always loads).

auth.description: Site authentication (password, JWT or OAuth). Managed from the Dashboard security settings; edit there rather than by hand

icon.description: Icon name from Lucide React icon library

httpMethod.description: HTTP method for API endpoint pages

brand.description: Primary brand color for buttons, links, and accents. Hex format

link.description: Target URL. Supports mailto: and tel: protocols

navbar.description: Navbar configuration with action buttons and links

robots:index.description: Allow search engines to index pages

robots:follow.description: Allow search engines to follow links

siteUrl.description: Canonical site URL used in metadata and sitemaps

ai.description: AI assistant and page action configuration

ai-assistant:enabled.description: Enable or disable the AI assistant chat widget

ai-assistant:position.description: Position adjustment for the floating AI assistant. 'bottom-spaced' adds extra bottom margin to avoid overlapping third-party chat widgets

page-actions.description: Actions available on each documentation page. Options: 'copy' (copy page content), 'view' (view source), 'claude', 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'grok' (open in AI chat), 'mcp' (Model Context Protocol)

ai-assistant:style.description: Display style. 'default' opens as a side panel, 'floating' opens as a chat bubble popup

ai-assistant:default-open.description: Open the assistant panel on page load

ai-assistant:captcha-enabled.description: Require a captcha before the first assistant message

ai-assistant:starter-questions.description: Up to three suggested questions shown before the first message

feedback.description: Feedback widget configuration for documentation pages

reactions.description: Show thumbs up/down reaction buttons on pages

survey.description: Show contextual survey prompt after a reaction

github-issues.description: Show 'Raise an issue' link on pages. Requires github-repo to be set

github-repo.description: Public GitHub repository URL for issue creation (e.g., 'https://github.com/org/repo'). Required when github-issues is true

integrations.description: Third-party analytics, session replay, and chat widget integrations. Each key is a provider name containing its required configuration fields

server.description: Custom Plausible server hostname. Defaults to 'plausible.io'

cookies.description: Cookie consent configuration. Each key is a consent category name, and its value defines the cookie/localStorage key-value pair to check for consent. Scripts and integrations assigned to a category only load when the matching value is found in the browser.

key.description: Cookie or localStorage key to check

value.description: Substring to match in the stored value

telemetry.description: Controls built-in page view analytics (Documentation.ai telemetry)

enabled.description: Set to 'false' to disable page view tracking. Defaults to enabled.

category.description: Consent category for telemetry. Defaults to 'analytics'.

source.description: Incoming path pattern to match. Supports dynamic segments with :paramName syntax

destination.description: Target path to redirect to. Can include dynamic parameters from source

statusCode.description: HTTP status code for the redirect

title.description: Display name shown in navigation and browser title

path.description: Relative path to MDX file without .mdx extension

href.description: External URL for links that open in new tabs. Use instead of path

tags.description: Categorization tags for organizing related content

badge.description: Short label displayed as a colored pill next to the page title in the sidebar (e.g., 'New', 'Beta', 'Deprecated'). Only include when needed

show-sidebar.description: Controls left sidebar visibility. Set to false to hide the sidebar and expand content to full width. Omit or set true for default behavior

show-toc.description: Controls right-side Table of Contents panel visibility. Set to false to hide the TOC. Omit or set true for default behavior

show-parent-label.description: Controls group/parent name label above the page title. Set to false to hide it. Omit or set true for default behavior

content-width.description: Controls the max-width of the content area. 'narrow' for focused reading, 'normal' for standard layout, 'wide' for full-width content. Omit for default 'normal'

public.description: Controls visibility in partial authentication mode

access-roles.description: Array of role names controlling access with JWT or OAuth authentication. Only users whose token contains at least one matching role can view this page. Inherits from nearest parent if not set

openapi.description: Connects a specific OpenAPI endpoint to this page. Format: 'filepath METHOD /endpoint' (e.g., 'api-reference/openapi.yaml GET /users/{id}')

openapi-mode.description: Controls content injection when using page-level openapi. 'auto' injects full documentation, 'custom' injects only playground and examples

show-page-navigation.description: Controls the previous/next page links at the bottom. Omit or set true for default behavior

ask-feedback.description: Controls the "Was this helpful?" feedback widget. Omit or set true for default behavior

nestedGroup.description: Nested group within a pages array

group.description: Display name shown in the sidebar navigation

expandable.description: When true, renders as an accordion that users can expand/collapse. When false, pages display inline with normal group styling, making pages and groups visually co-exist without accordion behavior.

openapi.description: OpenAPI spec for auto-generated API pages: a repo-relative path (e.g. 'api-reference/openapi.yaml') or an http(s) URL

hidden-apis.description: Array of API endpoints to exclude from auto-generation. Format: 'METHOD /path' (e.g., ['DELETE /users/{id}', 'POST /admin/reset'])
